title: Wii Sports Theme
blurb: The Wii Sports theme — the jaunty piano tune that opened millions of family evenings in 2007. It is pure distilled nostalgia: hearing it summons memories of wrist straps, broken TVs, and grandmothers unexpectedly dominating at bowling. One of the most beloved video game themes ever written, for reasons that have nothing to do with the game.
origin: The main theme from Wii Sports (Nintendo, 2006).
